If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast to match recent 5-day average for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, reverse direction and increase forecast by 2–3% for next 3–5 days.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is above true value, reduce forecast by 2–3% for early horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is 0.67+ and true value exceeds forecast by >3%, increase forecast by 2–4% for next 5–7 days to capture momentum.
